description: This file contains the StatisticalValidations class, which provides static methods to validate and convert various input values (float, int, bool) within the statistical calculations module of PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: StatisticalValidations
classes.description: Provides validation methods for numeric and boolean values used in statistical calculations.

methods.name: validateFloat
methods.description: Validates that input is numeric and returns it as float; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates that input is numeric, floors it, and returns as int; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: validateBool
methods.description: Validates that input is boolean or numeric, returns as boolean; throws exception if invalid.
